title: Catalytic Reaction Pool with Coffee-Mat Filtration Station
description: A chemistry lab features a large reaction pool filled with colored liquid reagents and a coffeemat repurposed as a molecular filtration membrane station beside it. The user must combine reagents in the pool following conservation-of-mass rules, filter products through the coffeemat station, and manage a multi-step synthesis chain with full undo/redo support across all operations.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an interactive chemistry lab. Load 'shared_assets/pool.glb' centered at origin as a large reaction vessel pool, scaled appropriately (scale ~2). Load 'shared_assets/coffeemat.glb' positioned to the right (x+3) as a filtration membrane station, scaled ~1.5, slightly elevated (y+0.5). Use PerspectiveCamera at (0,5,8) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (0.4 intensity), a directional light from (5,10,5), and a point light above the pool tinted blue-green. Create an HTML overlay panel on the left with 6 reagent buttons: HCl, NaOH, CuSO4, AgNO3, NaCl, FeCl3, each color-coded. Clicking a reagent adds it to the pool, visualized by spawning a small colored sphere that drops into the pool with simple animation. Track all added reagents in an array respecting conservation of mass: total moles in must equal moles out. When two compatible reagents are present (e.g., HCl+NaOH, AgNO3+NaCl, CuSO4+NaOH), they react automatically—merge their spheres into a new product sphere with blended color and a particle burst effect. The user must then drag product spheres onto the coffeemat to filter them, which triggers a glow animation on the coffeemat and splits the product into precipitate (stays on mat, darker color) and filtrate (returns to pool, lighter color). Implement a multi-input coupling rule: certain reactions only proceed if a prior filtrate is already in the pool, creating a 3-reaction synthesis chain requiring 10-12 steps total. Add Undo and Redo buttons that revert or replay each discrete action (reagent add, reaction, filter, drag) using a command-pattern history stack. Display a status bar showing current pool contents, total mass, and synthesis progress (0-100%). All mass values must remain conserved across undo/redo. Use raycasting for drag interactions on product spheres. Add subtle water ripple animation in the pool using vertex displacement on a semi-transparent plane.
